sarcasm_and_irony.nature: Marked and infrequent compared to Western languages; sarcasm in Japanese is often expressed through excessive, razor-sharp exaggerated politeness (慇懃無礼 Ingin Burei - polite rudeness).
sarcasm_and_irony.example: それはそれはご立派なことでございますね (My, how splendid that is for you [drenched in sarcastic contempt]).
